goal: Classify K scalar words once and project B2 private rows using the solver wire indices.

bodies.ordinary: fresh solver with the original curve join tree
bodies.gate: paired K/B2 branch concurrent with A/H, ordinary independent classification
bodies.projected: same paired branch, one K classification and a checked first-occurrence B2 projection

criterion: Ordinary versus frozen paired median within 2% on both inputs. Projected needs lower paired median and at least 6/8 wins per input against frozen, ordinary and gate.
route_checks: Projected mode must select projection on each normal request. Gate runs the paired branch with no projection. Zero optional workspace must still produce a valid proof while forbidding successful projection.
clocks: Projection preparation is clocked separately and ends before the K and B2 query clocks start. Diagnostic only.
